title: Lundey component diagram
description: Lundey, an original maze chase: the browser plays the whole game, and the Worker only decides who may fetch it.

components.name: Lundey
components.responsibility: One game: the browser game and its Worker, built and deployed together.

components.name: Browser game
components.responsibility: The engine, the drawing, the controls, the sound and the page's loop; keeps the best score in the browser.

components.name: Worker
components.responsibility: Serves the built game to players who hold games:lundey; keeps nothing.

components.name: icelander.net login service
components.responsibility: Who is signed in to icelander.net, and which games: roles they hold.

relationships.description: Built by build.mjs, with public/, into dist/games/lundey/.
Serves the built page and game.js as static assets; the two exchange nothing else.
Asks, on every request, whether the visitor is signed in and holds games:lundey.
